intro.h2: Beautiful on the surface, solid underneath
paragraphs: J&M Floor and Bathroom Construction handles bathroom remodeling in Palmetto Bay and Miami from the pipes up. The finished rooms are bright, with marble-look tile from floor to ceiling, but customers keep talking about the parts you never see.

In one master bathroom the crew found mold from an old leak nobody knew about and a shower pan that was completely broken. Jose Alberto put in a new shower pan, fixed every leak and finished with new accessories and vanity lights. A guest bathroom got new pipes and better drainage before its new tile went up. As that homeowner put it: more than just beauty on the surface.

items.name: Complete bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Master and guest bathrooms taken back to the walls and rebuilt, from the plumbing to the last towel bar. The before and after of one guest bath shows dated textured walls turned into floor-to-ceiling marble-look tile with a curbless shower.

image.alt: Remodeled guest bathroom with white marble-look porcelain, curbless walk-in shower and LED mirror

items.name: Shower pans and leak repair
items.blurb: A broken shower pan can hide leaks and mold for years. In one master bathroom the crew replaced a completely broken pan, fixed all the leakages behind it, then retiled the shower so it looks new and stays dry.

image.alt: Shower with blue-gray marble-look porcelain tile and recessed niche after a new shower pan

items.name: Pipes and drainage
items.blurb: New pipes and improved drainage are part of the job when they need to be. One homeowner says everything works better than before, with new pipes, enhanced drainage, comfort and reliability throughout their remodeled guest bathroom.

items.name: Floor installation
items.blurb: Floors are in the company name. The photos show bathroom floors finished in wood-look plank tile and large marble-look porcelain. One early customer hired J&M to remodel her bathroom floors and called it the best quality for the best price.

items.name: Vanities, lighting and accessories

items.title: They fix what is hidden
items.text: Mold from an old leak, a broken shower pan, tired pipes: reviewers say the crew found and fixed problems behind the walls instead of tiling over them.

items.title: On time and clean
items.text: Reviewers single out timeliness more than once. Customers describe the crew as clean, on time, very responsive and attentive from start to finish.

items.title: Careful planning
items.text: One homeowner praised the attention to detail and the careful planning and execution of bathroom fundamentals, not just the finished look.

items.title: Free estimates and long hours
items.text: Free estimates are printed on the company's business card, and the phone is answered from 6 AM to 9 PM on weekdays and from 9 AM to 2 PM on Saturday.

about.text: J&M Floor and Bathroom Construction is a bathroom and flooring company serving Palmetto Bay and Miami. Jose Alberto leads the crew, and his is the name customers mention when they talk about knowledgeable advice and a job done right. The company's Google reviews go back six years, starting with new bathroom floors. Today the work covers full bathroom remodels: new shower pans, pipes and drainage, tile, floors, vanities and lighting. Homeowners describe the team as professional, timely and fantastic at their job, and say their remodeled bathrooms are something they can't wait to show off.

image.alt: Gray marble-look tiled shower with niche, handheld shower and low curb

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.text: Call (786) 608-0337 or email to set up a free estimate. Weekday hours run from 6 AM to 9 PM.

steps.title: Inspect and plan
steps.text: We look at what is behind the tile too, like the shower pan, pipes and drainage, and plan the remodel around it.

steps.title: Rebuild and finish
steps.text: The crew fixes leaks and plumbing first, then installs tile, floors, vanity, lighting and the accessories you choose.

steps.title: Clean finish
steps.text: When the work is done, you get a clean, finished room. Reviewers describe the crew as very clean, responsive and attentive from start to finish.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Palmetto Bay and Miami
service_area.text: J&M Floor and Bathroom Construction is listed on Google in Palmetto Bay, Florida, and on Nextdoor as a Miami business, and the crew comes to your home. If you live in Palmetto Bay, Miami or nearby and have a bathroom or floor that needs work, call (786) 608-0337 for a free estimate and ask whether your neighborhood is covered. Weekday hours start at 6 AM.

items.a: Yes. Free estimates are printed right on the J&M business card. Call (786) 608-0337 or email jmfloorandbathroomconst@gmail.com with a few photos of your bathroom or floor, and we will set up a time to come out, look at it and talk about what you want.

items.q: My shower leaks. Can you fix it?
items.a: Yes. A broken shower pan can let water get behind the walls for years before anyone notices. J&M replaces failed shower pans and fixes the leaks before any new tile goes up. If you see stains, soft spots or mold around your shower, call (786) 608-0337 and ask the crew to take a look.

items.q: Do you replace pipes and drains?
items.a: When the job needs it, yes. On one guest bathroom remodel the homeowner says everything works better than before, with new pipes and enhanced drainage throughout. We look at the plumbing as part of the remodel, not only the tile and fixtures you see.

Yes. Flooring is right there in the company name. Customers have hired J&M to remodel bathroom floors, and the photos include wood-look plank tile and large marble-look porcelain. Call to talk about the room and the type of floor you have in mind, and ask whether it fits the job.
We are open Monday through Friday from 6 AM to 9 PM and on Saturday from 9 AM to 2 PM. We are closed on Sunday. Early and evening hours mean you can usually call before or after your own workday.

final_cta.h2: Ready for a bathroom you want to show off?
final_cta.text: Call J&M for a free estimate on your bathroom or floor.
